compiled_state.title: T0(UPDATE): Extend validate_escape_rationale with diff_text param for criterion-1 check
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE

Extend validate_escape_rationale in proximity.py to optionally check criterion 1 (referenced token present in diff context). Must remain backward-compatible: existing callers pass no diff_text and behavior is unchanged.

## File
plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/proximity.py

## Change
Add diff_text: str = '' parameter to validate_escape_rationale signature:

def validate_escape_rationale(escape_text, prior_cited_lines, overlap_region, diff_text='') -> bool:
    ...
    # When diff_text is non-empty: after confirming criterion 2+3, also verify
    # that at least one referenced token (line reference or word from escape_text)
    # appears in diff_text. If not, return False (criterion 1 fail).

When diff_text is empty string, criterion 1 is skipped (fail-open for callers without diff context).

## Also update tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_proximity.py
Add UPDATE test cases:
- test_escape_rationale_fails_when_token_absent_from_diff: token is outside prior/overlap but not in diff_text → returns False
- test_escape_rationale_passes_when_diff_text_empty: existing behavior — criterion 1 skipped when diff_text=''
- test_escape_rationale_512_char_boundary: escape_text = 512 chars (schema max length) → evaluated correctly

## Acceptance
- Existing 4 tests in test_proximity.py still pass
- 3 new UPDATE tests pass
- Signature change is backward-compatible (default diff_text='')
- ruff check passes
